children: CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday that his company’s manufacturing capacity is unable to keep up with order backlog for its Cybertruck before the EV maker winds down its production next year.
The billionaire investor on Friday announced that the production of the stainless-steel pickup will come to a halt at the company’s Texas gigafactory in mid-2027 to make room for

With Musk calling it an “end of an era” for the vehicle, car enthusiasts expected the Cybertruck to become a prized collector's item in the years to come, sparking renewed interest given its futuristic design.

“The Tesla Cybertruck order backlog is currently far more than we can make before dismantling the line for Cybercab expansion around June/July next year,” Musk wrote on X, noting that the company is adding an extra shift to ship all deliveries on time. "We will add an extra shift to try to get all orders done in time," he said.

title: Musk says Tesla Cybertruck demand is outpacing production
